coverage.design_evaluation_explanation: Matches 4 of 7 ground-truth variable items (57%): the two baseline prompts, 23-task BBH benchmark, 20%/80% optimization/test split, and optimization-set accuracy scoring of optimized instructions and baselines.
coverage.design_error_analysis: The model configuration does not specify the required PaLM 2-L-IT optimizer with text-bison scorer unambiguously, instead offering several alternatives. Optimization starts from multiple seeded prompts rather than only an empty instruction. Although per-task accuracy differences are calculated, the required >5% improvement in at least 19 or 20 tasks is replaced by a >1% win threshold and aggregate significance criteria.
coverage.conclusion_evaluation_explanation: The conclusion_output is empty and therefore does not semantically match the ground-truth conclusion.
coverage.conclusion_error_analysis: Missing the conclusion that OPRO-optimized instructions outperform the baselines by over 5% on the majority of tasks.
